name: Bell of Returning Allies
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Slot none; CL 11th; Weight ½ lb.; Aura strong conjuration

DESCRIPTION

This tiny golden bell can be attuned to one willing outsider you know by name, and can summon it to your side once per day for 1 minute. This can be any creature that you could select as a monster cohort. The attuned outsider’s name appears in embossed letters on the bell’s brim.

Summoning the outsider requires speaking its name aloud and ringing the bell. Only an outsider whose alignment is within one step from yours can be attuned to the bell.

Attuning the bell to another creature requires 24 hours of uninterrupted prayer.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells planar ally
